## v1.3.0 — 2026-10-07

**A new icon, a messages panel, light mode, Traditional Chinese, unread badges, quieter notifications and photo/video downloads — and InstaDesktop now recovers by itself and keeps itself up to date while it runs.**

### ✨ Highlights

- **New icon** — A new camera icon on the taskbar, in the tray, the title bar and the installer, sharp at every display scale.
- **Messages panel** — Your inbox in a floating panel like a messenger pop-out, showing only your chats: a slim header with the unread count, a pin to keep it on top, and a button to open the conversation in the main window. Profiles, posts and reels opened from a chat show in the main window. It first appears above the right end of the taskbar and remembers where you put it. Open or hide it with the chat button in the title bar, Ctrl+Shift+M, the tray menu or the taskbar jump list; it comes back instantly where you left off.
- **Light or dark** — Settings > General > Appearance follows Windows by default, or choose Light or Dark. InstaDesktop and Instagram change together.
- **繁體中文** — InstaDesktop's own menus, settings and notices are available in Traditional Chinese; it follows your Windows language, or choose in Settings > General > Language.
- **Mute a conversation** — Choose **Mute for 8 hours** on a message notification. Settings > Notifications shows how many are muted and can unmute them all.
- **Hide message content** — Notifications show who wrote, but not the text or any image.
- **Taskbar flash and jump list** — The taskbar button flashes for a new message while InstaDesktop is open but not in front. Right-click it to open Home, Messages, Reels, Explore or the messages window, or to pause notifications for an hour.
- **Shortcuts from anywhere** — Ctrl+Alt+I shows or hides InstaDesktop and Ctrl+Alt+M the messages panel from any app; change them in Settings > Keyboard shortcuts. Ctrl+/ or F1 lists every shortcut.
- **One notification per conversation** — More messages from the same chat update its notification ("+2 earlier in this conversation") instead of piling up in Action Center. Message notifications can also open in the messages panel.
- **Open where you left off** — InstaDesktop reopens on the page you used last, such as Messages.
- **Export diagnostics** — Settings > Advanced saves a zip of versions, settings choices and the app log to attach to a bug report; it contains no messages, names or page addresses.
- **Download photos and videos** — Right-click a photo or video in a post, a reel, a story or a chat and choose **Download photo** or **Download video**. Photos are saved at full resolution and videos as one MP4 with sound, named after the account and post (for example `instagram_Dd9RyBWBVih.mp4`), in your download folder. Please respect the rights of the people who posted them.
- **Clear cache** — Settings > Advanced fixes pages that load incorrectly without signing you out.
- **Unread badge** — The number of unread messages appears on the taskbar button and in the window title, and the tray icon gets a red dot. It can be turned off in Settings > Notifications.
- **Pause notifications** — Right-click the tray icon > *Pause notifications* for 1 hour, 8 hours or until tomorrow morning. A new **Notification sound** switch silences them without turning them off.
- **Downloads without a dialog** — Photos and videos you download go straight to your Downloads folder, or a folder you choose in Settings > Downloads. Turn on *Ask where to save each download* for the old behavior.
- **Calls on top** — Keep call windows above other windows: Settings > Calls, or right-click a call window's title > *Always on top*.
- **Your updates, your choice** — After an update, a notice links to what's new. Settings > Updates has **Check for updates**, and with *Install updates automatically* off, InstaDesktop tells you when a version is ready and installs it when you click.
- **Recovers by itself** — If Instagram cannot load (for example, Windows started InstaDesktop before the network was ready) or the browser crashes, InstaDesktop retries automatically, and right away when the network comes back or the PC wakes from sleep. Notifications no longer stop until you open the window and press Retry.
- **Zoom** — Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 or Ctrl+mouse wheel. The zoom level is remembered; when it is not 100%, the title bar shows it and a click resets it.
- **Updates while running** — InstaDesktop also checks for updates every 6 hours. A new version is installed only while the window is hidden or minimized and no call is open, and an app that was in the tray goes back to the tray.

### 🛠️ Improvements

- Ctrl+1 / 2 / 3 / 4 open Home, Messages, Reels and Explore.
- Changing **Hardware acceleration** offers to restart InstaDesktop right away.
- A page that is only busy for a moment is no longer replaced as "not responding", so a call window stays open.
- Instagram's dark background and hidden scrollbars apply before the page appears, without a flash after each load.
- Downloaded update installers are removed afterwards.
- Unused leftovers of an old customization feature were removed: the hidden sidebar, the *Reload customization* tray item, Ctrl+Shift+R and the *Open assets folder* button. The installer removes the old `Assets` folder.

### 🐛 Fixes

- Fixed: After a browser crash, **Retry** never worked and InstaDesktop had to be restarted.
- Fixed: Going back and forward quickly, or clicking a notification while a page was loading, could show "Instagram could not load".
- Fixed: Ctrl+1–4 did nothing.
- Fixed: Emoji font updates did not reach existing installations.
- Fixed: An update installed at sign-in opened the main window instead of returning to the tray.
- Fixed: The tray icon was cropped instead of scaled down when it showed the unread dot.

### 🔄 Updating

Existing users can simply launch InstaDesktop. If an update is available, the app downloads the latest installer from this Release and upgrades automatically.

Manual installation is also available:

1. Download **`InstaDesktop-Setup.exe`** below.
2. Run it; your profile and settings are preserved.

### 📦 Downloads

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `InstaDesktop-Setup.exe` | Recommended per-user Windows installer |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for downloaded files |

### ✅ Verification

- Windows 10/11 x64
- Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime
- Automated: smoke test (now including crash and offline recovery, zoom, shortcuts, the unread badge, pausing notifications, direct downloads, call windows on top, light and dark, Traditional Chinese, the messages window, clear cache, the jump list, taskbar flash, muting, global shortcuts, the shortcuts list, diagnostics export and photo/video downloads from public posts), 285 notification and update checks, 103 microphone, camera and call window checks, window layout
- Installer upgrade checked in an isolated test installation: old `Assets` removed, return to the tray after an update

### ⚠️ Known Issues

- About 19 of the newest emoji (Unicode Emoji 17 and 18) are not drawn by Twemoji yet and still use the Windows display.
- When Instagram only shows "N new messages" for a conversation, the notification shows that summary instead of the text.
- Turning off **Allow camera** during a call also interrupts that call's audio; Instagram can request the microphone again without a new prompt.

### 🔐 Security & privacy

No credentials or profile data are included in release assets. Update downloads use HTTPS from this repository's Releases, and the installer's SHA-256 is verified before execution.
